title: Monitorovací soustava
description: Předmět plnění jednotlivých částí veřejných zakázek je podrobně specifikován v přílohách této zadávací dokumentace. • část 1 - serverová centrála • část 2 - monitor VF s dotykovým displejem • část 3 - monitorace těžké případy + monitorace lehké případy + telemetrické jednotky Předmětem plnění všech částí veřejné zakázky je dodávka nového vybavení včetně příslušenství se zárukou za jakost a plnou provozuschopnost min. 24 měsíců (případné požadavky na delší záruční dobu jsou uvedeny v technické a funkční specifikaci požadovaných zařízení). Předmět plnění veřejné zakázky bude zahrnovat i instalaci, montáž a uvedení dodaných zařízení do provozu. Dodávka, instalace, zaškolení obsluhy a uvedení zařízení do provozu v místě plnění veřejné zakázky musí být provedeny v souladu s platnými právními předpisy ČR a normami a dle obecně závazných předpisů a doporučených metodik výrobce. Součástí nabídkové ceny bude provádění validací nebo PBTK (periodických bezpečnostně technických kontrol) dodávaných přístrojů po dobu záruční doby (dle zákona č. 375/2022 Sb., o zdravotnických prostředcích, v platném znění) tam, kde se jedná o zdravotnický prostředek. Předmětem plnění všech částí veřejné zakázky je dodávka nového vybavení včetně příslušenství se zárukou za jakost a plnou provozuschopnost min. 24 měsíců (případné požadavky na delší záruční dobu jsou uvedeny v technické a funkční specifikaci požadovaných zařízení). Předmět plnění veřejné zakázky bude zahrnovat i instalaci, montáž a uvedení dodaných zařízení do provozu. Dodavatel v rámci nabídky na plnění všech částí veřejné zakázky položkově specifikuje předmět dodávky příslušné části veřejné zakázky, v rámci které nabídku podává, a to v návaznosti na technickou a množstevní specifikaci příslušné části veřejné zakázky, popsanou v zadávací dokumentaci (technická a obchodní specifikace příslušné části veřejné zakázky), tak, aby bylo možné o jednotlivých dodávaných zařízeních následně samostatně účtovat. Pro obsah nabídky a případně uzavřené smlouvy je však vždy závazný obsah technické a obchodní specifikace příslušné části veřejné zakázky (zejména údaje uvedené ve Formuláři nabídky), takže chybné uvedení množství nabízených přístrojů či neuvedení některých z nich v soupisu dodávky není pro posouzení nabídky relevantní a slouží pouze k účetnímu rozpadu nabídkové ceny pro potřeby účtování o jednotlivých položkách dodávky.

title: Netherlands – Recruitment services – Brugbediening
description: De gemeente Nieuwegein heeft sinds 2021 een overeenkomst voor de dienstverlening voor de uitvoering en borging van de benodigde brugbediencapaciteit, welke eind april 2027 afloopt. Ter waarborging van het op een rechtmatige en doelmatige manier blijven invullen van de benodigde brugbediencapaciteit voor de komende jaren wordt de opdracht opnieuw in de markt belegd. De opdracht heeft betrekking op het beschikbaar stellen, organiseren en waarborgen van voldoende gekwalificeerde brugbediencapaciteit voor de uitvoering van de brugbedieningswerkzaamheden binnen het bedieningsgebied, inclusief de daarmee samenhangende personele en operationele coördinatie, planning, roostering, vervanging, continuïteitsborging en kwaliteitsborging. Hiervoor wenst de gemeente met één (1) opdrachtnemer een Raamovereenkomst af te sluiten. De waarde van de opdracht wordt geraamd op een inzet van 9.200 uren per jaar en 36.800 uren over vier (4) jaar. De geraamde jaarlijkse afname is daarmee € 450.000, - (excl. BTW). De totale geraamde waarde over de gehele looptijd van de opdracht (4 jaar) is daarmee € 1.800.000, - (excl. BTW). De geraamde waarde is gebaseerd op de verwachte benodigde dienstverlening, historische afname en kosten en huidige uurtarieven in de markt. Ingeval wij meer dan 200% boven de hierboven geraamde totale contractwaarde uitkomen, zal een nieuwe aanbesteding worden opgezet. De maximale afname onder de Raamovereenkomst bedraagt daarmee € 3.600.000, - (excl. BTW).

Perceel 1 betreft de levering van ICT hardware van devices (laptops, tablets desktops, netwerkapparatuur en dergelijke) voor de eindgebruikers in het voortgezet onderwijs. Perceel 1 wordt gegund aan de vijf inschrijvers met de economisch meest voordelige inschrijving gebaseerd op de beste prijs-kwaliteitverhouding. Perceel 2 betreft de levering van ICT hardware van audiovisuele presentatiemiddelen (digitale schoolborden, presentatieschermen, beamers en dergelijke) inclusief de bijhorende besturingssoftware. Perceel 2 wordt gegund aan de drie inschrijvers met de economisch meest voordelige inschrijving gebaseerd op de beste prijs-kwaliteitverhouding Zie inschrijvingsleidraad.

title: Ulkomaan kuljetukset 2026-2028 (2029-2030)
description: Ulkomaan kuljetukset 2026-2028 (2029-2030) Puolustusvoimien logistiikkalaitos (jäljempänä myös Hankintayksikkö) pyytää tarjoustanne ulkomaan kuljetuspalveluista. Hankinnan kohteena on erilaiset Puolustusvoimien ulkomaan kuljetukset: - kansainväliset tuonti- ja vientikuljetukset maantie-, ilma- ja merirahtikuljetuksina - kotimaan nouto- ja jakelukuljetukset Sopimuksen perusteella kuljetettavat materiaalit saattavat olla esimerkiksi: - kappaletavarakuljetuksia - kokokuormakuljetuksia - lämpötilasäädeltyjä - vaarallisia aineita (vaarallisuusluokissa 1-9, kattaen IATA-, ADR- ja IMDG määräykset) - vientivalvonnan alaisia puolustustarvikkeita (vientivalvonnan alaisilla puolustustarvikkeilla tarkoitetaan ITAR, KWKG, EAR, EC428/2009, C/2025/1499 tai vastaavien, vientivalvontasäädösten alaisia tuotteita) - anastusherkkää materiaalia - turvaluokiteltua materiaalia - ajoneuvoja - merikontteja - hankittavaa, korjattavaksi, lainaan, harjoituksiin sekä operaatioon menevää tai tulevaa materiaalia. Kuljetettavat materiaalit ovat Puolustusvoimien, muiden maiden asevoimien sekä yksityisen sektorin omistamia materiaaleja, kun ne liittyvät Puolustusvoimien toimintaan. Kaikki tarjouspyynnössä esitetyt kuljetukset sisältävät kaupallista materiaalia, jotka voidaan kuljettaa nykyisellään Ahvenanmaan aluevesillä. Tuotantoaikana mahdollisesti poikkeavat operatiiviset kuljetukset, jotka eivät ole kuljetettavissa Ahvenanmaan aluevesillä, hinnoitellaan erikseen puitesopimustoimijoiden kesken minikilpailuttamalla. Kilpailutuksen perusteella Hankintayksikön ja valittujen Tarjoajien välille solmitaan sopimus. Sopimus tulee Puolustusvoimien kaikkien hallintoyksiköiden käyttöön. Sopimuksen kesto on kaksi (2) vuotta 2026 - 2028 ja lisäksi optiona kaksi (2) vuotta 2029 - 2030. Hankintaan sisältyy puitejärjestelystä sopiminen, johon valitaan enintään kolme (3) Tarjoajaa päätöksenteon perusteet kohdan mukaisesti. Hankinnan ennakoitu arvonlisäveroton kokonaisarvo puitejärjestelyssä on n. 9.000.000,00 EUR. Puitejärjestely päättyy, mikäli edellä esitetty puitejärjestelyn enimmäisarvo tulee täyteen tai sopimuskausi päättyy. Hankinnan kohde ja sitä koskevat vaatimukset on kuvattu yksityiskohtaisesti tässä tarjouspyynnössä ja sen liitteissä.,

title: Astiat ja keittiötarvikkeet
description: HUS-yhtymä pyytää tarjouksia astioista ja keittiötarvikkeista. Hankintaan sisältyvät mm. astiat, ruoanlaittovälineet, keittiön pientarvikkeet, kattaus- ja esillepanotuotteet ja leipomotarvikkeet. Tuotteet on kuvattu tarkemmin tarjouspyynnön liitteessä 1 Tarjouslomake Hankinta on jaettu osiin, siten että päätös tehdään tuotekoreittain. Hankintalain 65 §:n mukaisesti hankintayksikkö on ennen hankintailmoituksen julkaisemista kuullut alalla toimivia yrityksiä. Hankinnasta on julkaistu tietopyyntö Hilma-palvelussa 25.8.2026, 589467-2026. Lisäksi hankintayksikkö on kuullut tietopyynnön yhteydessä ilmoittautuneita markkinatoimijoita lisäkeskusteluissa sekä tapaamalla kolme tietopyyntöön vastannutta yritystä. Hankinnan kohteeseen sisältyvät myös tarjottuihin tuotteisiin liittyvät lisätuotteet kuten lisäkoot ja -tarvikkeet, jotka ilmoitetaan Liite 1 Tarjouslomake välilehdellä "lisätarjouslomake". Sopimuskaudella voidaan lisäksi hankkia hankinnan ennakoidun arvon mukaisesti sopimuksen kohteena oleviin tuoteryhmiin kuuluvia tuotteita, joita ei ole yksilöity tuoteliitteessä (ks. sopimusluonnos). Sopimuskausi on voimassa 2 vuotta, jonka jälkeen se jatkuu toistaiseksi voimassa olevana. Hinnat ovat kiinteät varsinaisen sopimuskauden (2 vuotta) ajan. Kyseessä on useamman hankintayksikön yhteishankinta, joka toteutetaan hankintarenkaana. Tässä tarjouspyynnössä pyydettyjä tuotteita tulevat käyttämään: HUS-yhtymä (HUS) sekä Hyvinkään ravitsemuspalvelut Oy. Ks. tarkemmat tiedot tarjouspyynnön liitteessä 2 Sopimusluonnos. Hankinnan ennakoitu kokonaisarvo (alv 0 %) on yhteensä noin 640 000 euroa laskettuna neljän vuoden ajanjaksolle. Kyse on arviosta, eikä hankintayksikkö sitoudu ilmoitettuihin euromääriin ja tarjouspyynnössä ilmoitettuihin, toteutuneisiin kulutusmääriin. Lopulliset tilausmäärät voivat olla ilmoitettua suurempia tai pienempiä. Hankintapäätöksen jälkeen tarjottuja tuotteita ei lähtökohtaisesti voi vaihtaa toisiksi. Julkisen hankintamenettelyn lähtökohtana on tarjouksen lopullisuus (hankintalaki 74 § ja oikeuskäytäntö). Lisäksi hankintalain 136 § määrää, ettei sopimuksia saa olennaisesti muuttaa (tuotteiden vaihtaminen toisiksi katsottaisiin olennaiseksi muutokseksi). title: Tender regarding S-train Spare Parts and Maintenance agreement
description: DSB needs to enter into an agreement regarding spare parts and services connected to DSB's S-train fleet for the next 15 years. DSB is seeking a supplier to deliver • S-train OEM parts, including SIBAS and Traction Spare Parts • Repair services • Replacement Parts and Software (Re-engineered Parts and New Products) • Obsolescence management The full technical specifications for the above-mentioned services and parts can be found in Appendix 1 and Subappendix 1.A. The full list of spare parts can be found in Appendix 2. Appendix 2 specifies which parts are required to be delivered as Spare parts (tab 1-3). Appendix 2 also specifies which parts are required to be repaired and/or re-engineered (tab 4-5), and which parts are required to be attempted repaired or re-engineered (tab 6) based on whether the Spare parts are expected to be partially or fully obsolete. Appendix 2 (tab 7) lists which services are to be offered, cf. Appendix 1, including repair and re-engineering services. All remaining tender documents, including the full contract draft with appendixes and evaluation methods, will be made available after tenderes have confirmed interest. The contract will include clauses regarding • Quality Management System • Price regulation based on indexation, as well as extraordinary circumstances (hardship) if prices of materials and shipping increase drastically . • DSB’s Ethical Guidelines (Code of Conduct) • Railway Safety • Warranty (24 months for all parts, excluding repaired rotables, which will have a 12 month warranty) • Penalty for delays • Suppliers insurance for liability, covering no less than DKK 50 mill per occurrence and in the annual aggregate. • DSB’s right to audit Siemens is the original equipment manufacturer (OEM) supplier of the Spare Parts listed in Appendix 2, including Traction & SIBAS parts for the S-trains. DSB has limited or no documentation of the OEM Traction & SIBAS parts and limited access and no rights to protocols and software in relation to the OEM, Traction & SIBAS parts. However, DSB will provide available access for inspection of both systems after prequalification. To avoid time-consuming and expensive safety processes the Spare Parts and components must be OEM or equivalent. The contract value for the entire duration of the contract, is estimated to be between DKK 125 mill. and DKK 175 mill.

description: Hankinnan kohteena on OPH Oppimateriaalien vähälevikkisten suomen- ja ruotsinkielisten perusopetuksen tai toisen asteen oppimateriaalien kustannus- ja kuvatoimitus. Opetushallitus (jäljempänä OPH) on kansallinen koulutuksen, kielen ja kansainvälistymisen asiantuntija, kehittäjä ja palveluntuottaja. OPH Oppimateriaalit on OPH:n oppimateriaalikustantamo, joka täydentää kaupallisten kustantamojen valikoimaa ja kustantaa oppimateriaaleja pienille kohderyhmille. Oppimateriaaleja tehdään eri kouluasteille (perusopetus, toinen aste) ja hyvin monenlaisille oppijoille (mm. oppimisen tuki, harvinaiset kielet, katsomusaineet ja eri ammattialat) sekä suomeksi että ruotsiksi. OPH Oppimateriaalit sijoittuu viraston Oppimateriaalit ja julkaisut -yksikköön. description: Statsbygg ber i forbindelse med prosjekt: nr.: 1250901 navn: AHO – Ventilasjon og ENØK om tilbud på totalentreprise for utskifting og oppgradering av ventilasjonsanlegg samt gjennomføring av energiøkonomiserende tiltak (ENØK) ved Arkitektur- og designhøgskolen i Oslo (AHO) i Oslo. Bygget er på ca 15 700 m2 og ligger i Maridalsveien 29 i Oslo sentrum. Det vil bli avholdt en befaring for samtlige tilbydere den 25.11.26, kl. 08.00, i Maridalsveien 29, 0175 Oslo.

title: Anskaffelse av bistand til mobilisering og kompetanseheving i "Satsing Leverandørutvikling Finnmark" 2027-2030
description: Satsing Leverandørutvikling Finnmark er en videreføring av erfaringer og kompetanse opparbeidet gjennom "Prosjekt Leverandørutvikling Forsvaret". Prosjektet ble gjennomført i perioden 2020-2023 i Troms og Finnmark fylkeskommune, med bakgrunn i re-etableringen av Finnmark Landforsvar på Porsangmoen. Satsingen har til hensikt å øke den lokale verdiskapingen gjennom forsvarssektorens økende tilstedeværelse i Finnmark. Satsingen skal også bidra til at andre offentlige oppdragsgivere i Finnmark utnytter mulighetene for å gjøre innkjøp fra lokalt næringsliv. Hovedmålet for satsingen er å få flere lokale små og mellomstore bedrifter inn i leverandørporteføljen til forsvarssektoren og andre offentlige oppdragsgivere i Finnmark. Satsingen skal bidra til å øke lokal og regional verdiskapning i Finnmark. I tillegg har satsingen beredskapsmessige og sikkerhetspolitiske aspekter ved at et velutviklet regionalt og lokalt samfunns- og næringsliv bidrar til samfunnets totalberedskap.

title: VA- og VVS-materiell
description: Oppdragsgiver inviterer med dette til konkurranse for etablering av rammeavtale for kjøp og levering av VA-materiell fra grossist til drift og vedlikehold av vann- og avløpsledningsnett utendørs, og leveranse av VVS-materiell til innendørs bruk. Anskaffelsen gjelder Fredrikstad, Hvaler og Sarpsborg kommuner. Avtalen gjelder i all hovedsak varer til arbeider utført i egenregi, da kommunene Fredrikstad, Hvaler og Sarpsborg har løpende rammeavtaler for rørleggertjenester som omfatter både timer og medgått materiell.Fullstendig beskrivelse av leveransen følger av vedleggene til konkurransegrunnlaget.

title: Utskifting av ventilasjonsaggregater 36.01 og 36.02 – Atlanterhavsbadet
description: Bakgrunn Kristiansund kommune v/ Eiendomsdrift skal skifte ut eksisterende ventilasjons- og avfuktingsaggregater 36.01 og 36.02 ved Atlanterhavsbadet. Aggregatene er fra 2004 og er preget av alder og slitasje. Utskiftingen er nødvendig for å sikre stabil drift, tilfredsstillende luftkvalitet og god regulering av temperatur og luftfuktighet i bassengområdene. Formålet med anskaffelsen er å oppgradere ventilasjonsløsningen, forbedre energieffektiviteten og sikre driftssikre aggregater som er tilpasset et krevende bassengmiljø. Nye aggregater skal ha egnet materialkvalitet og korrosjonsbeskyttelse for kontinuerlig drift i fuktige og klorholdige omgivelser. Atlanterhavsbadet skal så langt som mulig opprettholde ordinær drift under utskiftingen. Arbeidene må derfor gjennomføres etappevis, med hensyn til begrenset tilkomst til tekniske rom, eksisterende installasjoner, sikkerhet og nødvendig koordinering med oppdragsgiver og eventuelle sideentreprenører. Beskrivelse av oppdraget Oppdraget omfatter prosjektering, dimensjonering, levering, demontering, inntransport, montering, idriftsettelse og dokumentasjon av nye ventilasjons- og avfuktingsaggregater for system 36.01 og 36.02 ved Atlanterhavsbadet. Leveransen skal gjennomføres som en samlet aggregatleveranse med prosjekterings-, monterings-, koordinerings- og funksjonsansvar innenfor de grensesnittene som er definert i konkurransegrunnlaget. Utskiftingen skal gjennomføres trinnvis, med aggregat 36.01 først og deretter 36.02, slik at badeanleggets drift påvirkes minst mulig. Leveransen omfatter blant annet: Komplette ventilasjons- og avfuktingsaggregater for system 36.01 og 36.02, inkludert nødvendig intern automatikk. Prosjektering og dimensjonering av tilbudt løsning, tilpasset ventilasjons- og avfuktingsbehovet i bassengområdene. Demontering av eksisterende aggregater, inntransport og montering av nye aggregater. Dokumentasjon av kapasitet, SFP-verdi, temperaturvirkningsgrad, varmegjenvinning, kuldemedium, materialvalg og korrosjonsbeskyttelse. Dokumentasjon av moduloppdeling, transportvei, inntransport, serviceareal og montasjeprinsipp. Koordinering mot eksisterende kanalnett, røranlegg, elektro, automasjon og SD-anlegg innenfor avtalte grensesnitt. Innregulering, funksjonstesting, idriftsettelse og prøvedrift. FDV-dokumentasjon og nødvendig opplæring av driftspersonell. Aggregatene skal være egnet for kontinuerlig drift i fuktig og klorholdig bassengmiljø, ha høy energieffektivitet og kunne integreres med eksisterende tekniske anlegg innenfor leverandørens ansvarsområde. Arbeider utenfor aggregatleverandørens definerte grensesnitt, herunder større kanaltilpasninger og nødvendige rør-, elektro- og bygningsmessige arbeider, utføres normalt av oppdragsgivers rammeavtalepartnere eller andre entreprenører, slik det fremgår av kravspesifikasjonen og prisskjemaet. Leverandøren skal utarbeide en gjennomføringsplan som beskriver hovedaktiviteter, rekkefølge, forventet nedetid og nødvendige tiltak for å ivareta drift og sikkerhet under utskiftingen. Planen skal også beskrive koordineringen med oppdragsgiver og eventuelle sideentreprenører. Nærmere krav til leveransen, tekniske spesifikasjoner, ansvarsfordeling og dokumentasjon fremgår av konkurransegrunnlagets del II, herunder II.30 Kravspesifikasjon VVS, prisskjema, miljøskjema og tilhørende tegninger, rapporter og øvrige vedlegg.

title: 2026/29: Servicedesk-løsning
description: Patentstyret, heretter kalt Oppdragsgiver, ønsker tilbud på avtale om Servicedesksystem.Patentstyret skal anskaffe en moderne, leverandørdriftet SaaS-basert Servicedesk-løsning. Løsningen skal understøtte brukerstøtte, tjenesteleveranse og sakshåndtering for innledningsvis IT, men skal innen kort tid utvides til flere tjenesteområder. Dette gjelder HR, Økonomi, Arkiv og administrative funksjoner. Løsningen skal inkludere Asset Management.Med Servicedesk-løsning menes den samlede SaaS-plattformen for brukerstøtte, tjenestehåndtering og sakshåndtering. Løsningen skal leveres som et standardprodukt som er skalerbart og konfigurerbart, og som videreutvikles som en del av leverandørens standardtjeneste.Anskaffelsen skal legge til rette for én tydelig inngang til tjenester, sporbar saksbehandling, effektiv samhandling, selvbetjening, automatisering og forbedring basert på rapportering og analyse. Løsningen skal bidra til raskere og mer ensartet behandling, redusert personavhengighet og økt kvalitet og forutsigbarhet i tjenesteleveransen.Inkludert i avtalen inngår også løpende konsulentbistand ved behov. Se bilag 1 for mer informasjon.

title: Rammeavtale for Trykkeritjenester
description: Nasjonal rammeavtale om trykking, lagerhold, distribusjon og bestillingsløsning for trykksaker, se konkurransegrunnlag for ytterligere informasjon.

title: 78162 Parallelle rammeavtaler for trombaferesemaskiner
description: Oslo universitetssykehus HF inviterer til åpen anbudskonkurranse om parallelle rammeavtaler for trombaferesemaskiner til Seksjon for blodgivning, Avdeling for immunologi og transfusjonsmedisin.Maskinene skal benyttes til trombaferese fra bloddonor med samtidig oppsamling av plasma. Det inngås parallelle rammeavtaler for utstyr med inntil to leverandører, rangert som leverandør nr. 1 og nr. 2. Avrop tildeles etter fast fordelingsnøkkel uten gjenåpning av konkurransen, jf. FOA § 26-3 første ledd.Rammeavtalene har en varighet på 4 år og et samlet maksimalt volum på 10 maskiner. Første avrop er én maskin. Rammeavtalene gir ingen kjøpsforpliktelse. Hvert avrop utgjør en kjøpskontrakt for den aktuelle maskinen i 10 år etter overtakelse, med opsjoner på serviceavtaler (PV-avtale og fullserviceavtale), servicetjenester og servicekurs.Utstyrsavhengig forbruksmateriell prises i samme konkurranse og inngår i evalueringen av kostnad, men omfattes av egen rammeavtale som inngås av Sykehusinnkjøp HF med de samme leverandørene som tildeles rammeavtale for utstyr.Rammeavtalen for utstyrsavhengig forbruksmateriell skal gjelde så lenge utstyret som omfattes av avtalen, er i bruk. Forbruksmateriellet er nødvendig for bruk av utstyret og må være kompatibelt med dette. Utstyret har en forventet levetid på mer enn fire år. Den lengre avtaleperioden er derfor begrunnet i særlige forhold knyttet til avtalens formål og oppdragsgivers behov, jf. FOA § 26-1 fjerde ledd. Rammeavtalene for utstyr har en varighet på 4 år.Tilbyder som tilbyr en modell som ikke allerede er i klinisk bruk hos Kunden, skal vederlagsfritt stille én maskin til utprøving hos Kunden i inntil 4 uker.Se konkurransegrunnlaget med vedlegg for fullstendig informasjon.

title: Avfallsanlegg Moskog - SUM
description: Administrasjonsbygg, verkstad og carport er første trinn i utbygging av nytt avfallsanlegg. Administrasjonsbygget skal innehalde kontorarbeidsplassar, møte- og opphaldsareal, garderobar, sanitærrom og andre naudsynte birom for den daglege drifta. Bygget er ca 850 m2 fordelt på to etasjar og skal byggast av tre. Verkstaden med vaskehall skal leggje til rette for vedlikehald, service og reinhald av køyretøy og maskinpark. I tillegg blir det lager for utstyr. Flatemålet er ca 750 m2. Carporten blir tak for opp til 8 storbilar. Det avgrensa uteområdet skal fyllast opp til og med bærelag.

title: Rammeavtale elektrikertjenester - Notodden kommune og Krødsherad kommune
description: Rammeavtalen gjelder utføring av elektroarbeid ved alle oppdragsgivers bygninger, anlegg og infrastruktur ved teknisk drift og vedlikehold med tilhørende materiell. Med elektroarbeid menes blant annet arbeid relatert til ombygging, tilbygg, påbygg, installasjon, løpende tilsyn/service, endring og vedlikeholdsarbeider av eksisterende bygningsmasse, både innvendig og utvendig. Utarbeide forslag til løsninger og utføre mindre prosjekteringsarbeid. Avtalen gjelder fortrinnsvis arbeider/oppdrag som er praktisk å gjennomføre på timebasis, men kan også brukes på arbeider i forbindelse med nybygg og rehabilitering. Rammeavtalen omfatter også kjøp av elektromateriell. Oppdragsgiver står fritt til å handle produkter fra andre leverandører på områder der vi har andre rammeavtaler. Anskaffelsens totale verdi anslåes til NOK 4 000 000, - eks MVA. per år. Angivelsen av årlige innkjøp er basert på tidligere historikk og basert på et skjønnsmessig estimat. Estimatet må ikke anses som forpliktende for innkjøp etter rammeavtalen. Innkjøp av elektrikertjenester vil variere fra år til år i tråd med Oppdragsgivers behov. Maksimalverdi, inkludert eventuelle opsjoner og forventet prisstigning: NOK 25 000 000, - eks MVA. Kontrakten har en varighet på 2 år fra signeringsdato med opsjon for oppdragsgiver til ytterligere forlengelse i inntil 2 år, med 1 år av gangen (2+1+1). Fullstendig beskrivelse av leveransen følger av kravspesifikasjonen.

title: R0013EBE - Rammeavtale for kjøp av gass
description: Formålet med rammeavtalen er å dekke Bergen kommune ved Etat for bygg og eiendom (EBE) sitt behov for levering av propangass til kommunale eiendommer med propananlegg som hovedkilde til oppvarming. Rammeavtalen inngås med én leverandør og omfatter tre sykehjem: Fyllingsdalen sykehjem, Ulset sykehjem og Åstveit sykehjem. Leverandøren overvåker tanknivåene ved hjelp av eksisterende automatiske nivåmålere og sørger for etterfylling, slik at eiendommene til enhver tid har nok propangass til normal drift. Transport og øvrige tjenester som er nødvendige for en sikker og pålitelig levering inngår i avtalen. Oppdragsgiver har opsjon på å inkludere ytterligere kommunale eiendommer med propananlegg i løpet av avtaleperioden. Anskaffelsen er en ren varelevering, og tilbudene evalueres kun på pris. Det vises for øvrig til oppdragsgivers spesifikasjon.

title: Prosjekt 1250901 AHO – Ventilasjon og ENØK, vinduer og takarbeider K201 Totalentreprise
description: Statsbygg ber i forbindelse med prosjekt: nr.: 1250901 navn: AHO – Ventilasjon og ENØK og bygningsmessige arbeider ved Arkitektur- og designhøgskolen i Oslo (AHO) Prosjektet omfatter utskifting og oppgradering av ventilasjonsanlegg, energiøkonomiserende tiltak og omfattende tilhørende bygningsmessige arbeider. Dette inkluderer blant annet konstruktive forsterkninger, arbeider på tak, utskifting av vinduer og oransje glassfasade, solskjerming og fallsikring på tak over plan 3. Arbeidene skal gjennomføres i et eksisterende undervisnings- og administrasjonsbygg i drift, med vernehensyn som skal ivaretas. Bygget er på ca. 15 700 m² og ligger i Maridalsveien 29 i Oslo. Formålet med prosjektet er å forbedre inneklima, driftssikkerhet og energieffektivitet. Oppdragsgiver er Kunnskapsdepartementet ved Statsbygg. Tilbudsbefaring avholdes 25.11.2026 kl. 08.00 i Maridalsveien 29, 0175 Oslo. Statsbygg åpner opp for at tilbydere kan be om ny befaring via Artifikportalen. Statsbygg vil publisere eventuell ny befaring.

title: Rammeavtale for kjøp av spesialinnredning og møbler
description: Stortinget har behov for å inngå rammeavtale med én leverandør for utvikling, produksjon, levering, montering og vedlikehold av spesialinnredning og spesialtilpassede møbler. Avtalen skal dekke behov som ikke kan ivaretas gjennom standardmøbler eller eksisterende møbelavtaler, og omfatter blant annet spesialtilpassede bord, skap, garderobeløsninger, møteinnredning, innbygging av teknisk utstyr og annet inventar tilpasset Stortingets lokaler.Stortingets bygningsmasse består av lokaler med ulike arkitektoniske uttrykk og vernehensyn. Leverandøren må derfor ha kompetanse til å utvikle og produsere løsninger som ivaretar både funksjonelle, estetiske og bygningsmessige krav, samt kunne bistå med utvikling av løsninger i samarbeid med Stortingets fagmiljøer.

title: France – Public road transport services – DELEGATION DE SERVICE PUBLIC RELATIVE A LA GESTION ET L’EXPLOITATIONDES SERVICES DE MOBILITE ET DE TRANSPORT DE VOYAGEURS SUR LETERRITOIRE DE CHATEAUROUX METROPOLE
description: La consultation a pour objet de déléguer la gestion et l’exploitation des services de mobilité et de transport de voyageurs sur le ressort territorial de la Communauté d’Agglomération de Châteauroux Métropole (Réseau Horizon) Châteauroux Métropole, autorité Organisatrice de la mobilité est autorité délégante. Les missions déléguées sont les suivantes: Offre de base : Exploitation et gestion des services de mobilité et de transports publics de personnes et à l’échelle du territoire communautaire selon les principes définis à l’article 5.1 du document programme. Les candidats devront obligatoirement répondre à l’offre de base et à l'option obligatoire.• Option obligatoire :Option N°1 : Exploitation et gestion d’un service de location de vélos L’option est décrite à l’article 5.2 du document programme. L’Autorité Délégante précisera, avant la remise de l'offre finale si l'option est levée. Le Délégataire assurera la gestion de ces services pour une durée de six (6) ans, à compter du 01/01/2028 et jusqu’au 31/12/2033 dans le cadre d’une délégation de service public (DSP) au sein du périmètre contractuel. Lieu d’exécution : Territoire de la Communauté d’Agglomération de Châteauroux Métropole(département de l’Indre). L’estimation de la valeur du contrat de concession est de 45 millions d’euros HT valeur décembre 2026 sur la durée du contrat. Les missions attendues sont l'organisation, la production et la commercialisation des services, ainsi que la réalisation de l'offre de transport et la maintenance des véhicules et outils de production.Le délégataire assurera en outre la gestion de la relation avec les usagers des transports scolaires qui sont assurés par le biais de marchés publics en cours. La future DSP intègre la gestion et l'exploitation des services de transport suivants sur l’ensemble du périmètre de l’Agglomération de Châteauroux Métropole : • Le réseau de transport en commun « Horizon » composé aujourd’hui de 12 lignes régulières, • Le service de transport adapté à la demande, « Handibus », à destination des personnes à mobilité réduite sur le périmètre de CM .Pour cette gestion déléguée, la collectivité met à la disposition du délégataire : • Un dépôt de bus réceptionné en 2021 avec une capacité de stationnement de 80 véhicules, équipé de bureaux, d’un atelier de maintenance, de stations de lavage et de carburant et d’équipements de recharge de véhicule électrique; • 31 autobus standard, 5 autobus articulé, 2 midibus. Ces véhicules sont équipés d’équipements de suivi par système SAEIV et cellules de comptage voyageurs. Plusieurs véhicules standard et articulés électriques ont également été commandés. • 2 midibus accessibles et équipés pour accueillir des PMR • Un Site Internet https://www.bushorizon.com/ La présente concession est passée sur le fondement du règlement 1370/2007 et de la directive 2014/23/CEE. La directive 2014/25/UE citée dans le présent avis concerne les marchés des secteurs spéciaux est non les concessions , elle ne s'applique pas à la présente consultation.

title: France – Maintenance of information technology software – Déploiement et maintenance du dispositif de l'Appli M - Relance après déclaration sans suite
description: L'Appli M est l'application mobile mise en oeuvre par le SMMAG pour permettre aux usagers de s'informer et de se déplacer facilement sur le territoire selon le mode de transport choisis. Le marché concerne le développement et la maintenance des briques technologiques sur lesquelles repose L'Appli M. Ces briques technologiques incluent la mise à disposition d'une plateforme pour permettre les interfaces avec les briques tierces (système de billettique lourde, partenaires de mobilité etc.) et la fourniture de briques métiers propres à L'Appli M (brique d'achat et de vente de titres dématérialisées, brique compte M etc.). L'accord-cadre sera exécuté par l'émission de bons de commande. Les prestations sont réglées par des prix unitaires et forfaitaires

title: Norway – Environmental monitoring other than for construction – Investigation of a water environment in Åkersvika Nature Reserve
description: Many physical, chemical and biological examinations were carried out in 2014 to document the pre-condition. title: France – Railway engineering services – Mission d'assistance à maîtrise d'ouvrage en support du grand projet Ambition Ferroviaire 2025 - Extension et modernisation des dessertes ferroviaires de Port 2000
description: Le GPFMAS poursuit les études et les investissements consacrés au développement et à la modernisation des dessertes ferroviaires de Port 2000, afin d'accompagner la mise en service des postes à quai 11 et 12 et la croissance attendue des trafics conteneurisés. L'opération vise à accroître durablement les capacités ferroviaires, à améliorer la fluidité et la robustesse des circulations, à réduire les conflits d'usage et à renforcer la performance du report modal vers le rail. L'opération est structurée en deux phases complémentaires. La phase 1 vise à accompagner la mise en service des postes à quai 11 et 12 par l'extension vers l'Ouest de la desserte ferroviaire, la création des raccordements aux installations ferroviaires des terminaux et l'adaptation des raccordements existants. La phase 2, qui constitue l'investissement structurant de moyen et long terme, vise à augmenter significativement les capacités ferroviaires de Port 2000 et à améliorer les performances de son exploitation. Elle comprend notamment la reconfiguration du plan de voies entre le faisceau de soutien composé de dix voies et les terminaux, le doublement, voire le triplement, de certaines sections, la création de nouvelles communications ferroviaires, ainsi que la modernisation des installations de signalisation, de commande et de télécommande des aiguilles et des itinéraires. Dans ce cadre, la mission confiée au titulaire constitue une assistance à maîtrise d'ouvrage ferroviaire à forte technicité, couvrant trois champs complémentaires : - l'assistance au maître d'ouvrage, pour la programmation, l'organisation et la conduite de cette opération complexe, ainsi que pour la coordination des acteurs et la maîtrise des interfaces ; - l'assistance technique au maître d'ouvrage et au maître d'oeuvre, par la mobilisation d'une ingénierie ferroviaire spécialisée durant les phases de conception, de réalisation, d'essais et de mise en service ; - l'assistance au gestionnaire de l'infrastructure ferroviaire, afin d'intégrer les exigences d'exploitation, de maintenance et de sécurité, de maîtriser les impacts sur les installations et les circulations existantes et d'accompagner les démarches réglementaires et de sécurité ferroviaire jusqu'à la mise en exploitation. Les prestations requièrent ainsi la mobilisation coordonnée d'expertises confirmées et diversifiées en conduite d'opérations ferroviaires complexes, en ingénierie ferroviaire, en exploitation et maintenance des infrastructures et en sécurité ferroviaire. La capacité du titulaire à intervenir sur un réseau maintenu en exploitation, à maîtriser de nombreuses interfaces techniques, opérationnelles et organisationnelles et à produire des avis indépendants, argumentés et directement exploitables par le GPFMAS constitue un enjeu déterminant de la mission

Der TuS Berne e.V. hat den Abbruch des alten Vereinshauses, der Fußballumkleide und Garagen geplant sowie die Errichtung eines neuen, modernen, barrierefreien Sportcampus' mit einem 2-geschossigen Multifunktionsgebäude, welches den Anforderungen an Klimaschutz, Barrierefreiheit und Flächeneffizienz gerecht wird. Das 2 geschossige Gebäude hat eine Grundfläche von ca. 1.140 m2. Geplant sind zwei Sporthallen inklusive Umkleiden, Kursräume, Verwaltungstrakt und eine kleine Gastronomie. Die Außenanlage wird mit einem Soccerfeld, Beachvolleyballfeld, Multifunktionsflächen, Pakrplatz umgestaltet. Das neue Gebäude soll fossilfrei betrieben werden und ohne einen Gasanschluss auskommen; das Dach soll teilweise begrünt und teilweise mit Photovoltaik zur Stromerzeugung ausgestattet werden. Es ist beabsichtigt, die Heizenergie über Geothermie zu gewinnen und durch Wärmepumpen effizient im Gebäude zu verteilen. Eine erste Visualisierung ist im Internet eingestellt https://youtu.be/SqZsF8YYdjs, der Baufortschritt unter der Internetanschrift des tus Berne "News NEUBAU Sportzentrum". Die Baumaßnahme wird gefördert durch den Senat der Freien und Hansestadt Hamburg sowie das Bezirksamt Wandsbek. Die Ausführung erfolgt in Bauabschnitten gemäß Bauzeitenplan. title: Netherlands – Overhaul and refurbishment work – Verbouwing, verduurzaming en groot onderhoud MFC de Keure
description: De gemeente Sluis is voornemens MFC De Keure te verbouwen, te verduurzamen en groot onderhoud uit te voeren. De opdracht omvat bouwkundige en installatietechnische werkzaamheden, waaronder de aanpassing van het gebouw voor de huisvesting van een bibliotheek en diverse zorgvoorzieningen. Daarnaast worden onderhouds- en verduurzamingsmaatregelen uitgevoerd. De werkzaamheden vinden gefaseerd plaats, waarbij het gebouw gedeeltelijk in gebruik blijft. De opdracht betreft de verbouwing, verduurzaming en het groot onderhoud van MFC De Keure in Sluis. De verbouwing ten behoeve van de nieuwe zorgvoorzieningen omvat circa 1.057 m² bruto vloeroppervlakte (BVO). De verduurzamings- en onderhoudswerkzaamheden hebben betrekking op circa 3.788 m² BVO van het overige gebouw. De werkzaamheden omvatten onder meer sloopwerkzaamheden, bouwkundige aanpassingen, binnen- en buitenafwerking, elektrotechnische en werktuigbouwkundige installaties en verduurzamingsmaatregelen. De opdracht wordt als een geheel aanbesteed en gefaseerd uitgevoerd, waarbij het gebouw gedeeltelijk in gebruik blijft. De totale uitvoeringstermijn bedraagt veertien (14) maanden na opdrachtverstrekking.

title: 5157/EFM/RH - Fire Alarm Maintenance Service
description: 5157/EFM/RH - Fire Alarm Maintenance Service The University of Sheffield is looking to contract with a supplier for the Provision of Fire Alarm Maintenance across the University of Sheffield campus and wider Advanced Mechanical Research Centre (AMRC) sites. The chosen Contractor will manage all works undertaken to the Fire Alarm Systems, working in accordance with the current edition of British Standard BS 5839-1:2025, including all current amendments and OPP_EG12 Electrical Services Guide. The Contractor will undertake all Planned Maintenance Activities and all reactive activities as required. Providing fully comprehensive maintenance cover 365 days per year, 24 hours per day. This is an open tender process following University process. The Invitation to Tender (ITT) can be downloaded by registering and expressing your interest on the University`s e-tendering system NEUPC Delta portal: NEUPC - Procurement Portal. Completed tenders must be returned through the same e-tendering system. A site visit is available to all potential bidders on Tuesday 1st of December 2026 from 13:00 to 15:00, at the University of Sheffield Main Campus. Attendance is limited to a maximum of two representatives per supplier. If you wish to attend, please confirm via the Delta Message Centre by 12 noon (UK time) on Friday 27th of November 2026. Access Code - Y28YU3S7Q5

title: CA18665 - Management of Sports Facilities for Community use
description: Purpose of the tender The specification sets out the arrangements for the management, operation and community use of the sports facilities situated at Cecil Jones Academy ("the Facilities"), Southend on Sea. The parties acknowledge that the Facilities have been developed to support: o Community participation in sport and physical activity; o Health, wellbeing and social inclusion; o Access to high-quality sporting facilities for local residents, clubs and community organisations; o The long-term protection, maintenance and enhancement of the Facilities. The Trust's primary objective is the delivery of community benefit. The Trust does not require the Facilities to generate a commercial profit. Any operating surplus generated through community use shall be reinvested into the maintenance, improvement and sustainability of the Facilities. 2. Facilities in scope o Full-size 3G Artificial Grass Pitch; o Outdoor Tennis/Netball Courts; o Sprint Track and Long Jump Facility; o Changing accommodation associated with the outdoor facilities o Spectator areas; o Car parking for community users, comprising 61 spaces including 5 accessible bays o Ancillary facilities used in connection with Community Use, namely the toilets, male and female, and first aid provision within the changing accommodation, floodlighting serving the 3G pitch and courts, and the access routes between the car park, changing accommodation and outdoor facilities. To access this competition: Registered: Login to https://suppliers.multiquote.com and view the opportunity CA18665. Not registered: Visit https://suppliers.multiquote.com then register and quote CA18665 as the reason for registration. Any queries please contact MultiQuote on 020 3920 8054.

title: Procurement of 3 personnel transport vehicles and 1 multi-purpose vehicle
description:
The municipalities of Zurzach, Mellikon, Fisibach, and Siglistorf are procuring three new personnel transport vehicles (PTF 2) and one multi-purpose vehicle (MZF) for the Zurzach base fire department.


These vehicles will be deployed within the municipal territory, the base department’s area of ​​responsibility, and for mutual aid in neighboring jurisdictions. The PTF 2 units and the MZF must feature a compact design and be suitable for use by a militia-style (volunteer/part-time) fire service. They are expected to have a service life of at least 20 years. The vehicles must meet the requirements specified in the tender documentation. Detailed technical requirements, equipment specifications, and delivery terms can be found in the tender’s requirements document.

title: Netherlands – Military vehicles and associated parts – Onbemenste Doorbraaksystemen
description: De opdracht betreft binnen een taakstellend budget een maximaal aantal onbemenste doorbraaksystemen (OBDS) maar tenminste zeven (7) te leveren, bestaande uit een compleet functionerende unmanned ground vehicle (UGV) met rupsbanden en alle noodzakelijke toebehoren voor het doorbreken van mijnenvelden, en een besturingsmodule voor het op afstand besturen van het complete systeem door middel van een afstandsbediening. De focus ligt op het doorbreken van explosieve hindernissen in de vorm van mijnenvelden. Vanwege deze opdracht worden strikte eisen gesteld op het gebied van rijeigenschappen en terreinwaardigheid zodat het systeem optimaal presteert in de beoogde operationele omgeving. Onderdeel van de opdracht betreft eveneens het leveren van een ILS-pakket, onderhoud en reservedelen, documentatie, industriële tent, opleiding en training. Daarnaast zal er een optie voor additionele OBDS, inclusief bijbehorende uitrustingssets etc. worden opgenomen. Achtergrond van deze verwerving is de wens van het Ministerie van Defensie om de beschikbare mijnenveld- en hindernisdoorbraakcapaciteit te verhogen, teneinde hiermee de freedom of movement van de eenheden op het gevechtsveld te vergroten. Daarnaast realiseert het OBDS, als aanvulling op de reeds binnen het Ministerie van Defensie bestaande mijnenveld- en hindernisdoorbraakcapaciteit, diversiteit binnen de mijnenveld- en hindernisdoorbraakcapaciteit, waardoor er meer mogelijkheden qua beschikbare middelen en wijze van inzet ontstaan. Mijnenveld- en hindernisdoorbraakcapaciteit, en specifiek de onbemenste variant, draagt bij aan de operationele gereedheid en output van de eenheden en vergroot de doorbraakmogelijkheden (en daarmee de mobiliteit) van eenheden. Daarnaast leidt de onbemenste variant eveneens tot een verhoogde bescherming van het personeel. Om invulling te geven aan de hier genoemde doelstellingen is het Materieel Logistiek Commando (MatLogCo) in opdracht van het Commando Land Strijdkrachten (CLAS) in samenwerking met Commando Materieel & IT (COMMIT) op zoek naar een marktpartij die in staat is de gevraagde OBDS te leveren, inclusief de bijbehorende goederen en diensten, en opties.

title: Ireland – Document management software package – Online Digital Preservation System
description: The Heritage Council now requires the Supply, Implementation, Licensing, Support and Maintenance of an Enterprise Grade integrated web‐based solution (SaaS) Digital Preservation System to support The Heritage Council. The solution should include: (a) an off‐the‐shelf software application requiring little or no customisation (b) support 5 administrator (Heritage Council staff), and inhouse users (staff) and a public facing ability to share selected data with the general public. (c) Customisable with the Heritage Council branding and colouring. (d) The solution should have the ability to ingest, store, manage, and control access to a wide range of digital content types, including documents, records, datasets, email, audio-visual assets and other digital materials. (e) The solution should be capable of managing associated metadata to support the organisation, discovery, and lifecycle management of preserved content. (f) The solution must integrate with enterprise platforms and systems Microsoft 365, SharePoint, etc and associated records/data management environments. The solution must be secure, resilient, and scalable, aligned with Heritage Council’s data protection, security, and regulatory requirements.

title: Space Campus Synopsis - Qatar Development of Al Udeid
description: The United States Air Force (USAF) has an operational requirement for the development of a new Space Campus at Al Udeid Air Base (AUAB), Qatar. To support this initiative, this SATOC will encompass comprehensive planning, design, and construction phase services. The required infrastructure consists of highly secure facilities mandated to meet Intelligence Community Directive (ICD) 705 compliance standards. The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Southwestern Middle East District (SWM), intends to award a single unrestricted Architect-Engineer (A-E) Indefinite Delivery Contract (IDC) which will be awarded as a Single Award Task Order Contract (SATOC). This procurement is conducted under 40 USC Chapter 11 (Selection of Architects and Engineers Statute, formerly Public Law 92-582 Brooks Architect-Engineer Act), as implemented by Revolutionary Federal Acquisition Regulation Overhaul (RFO) Part 36 and RFO Defense FAR Supplement (RFO DFARS) Part 36. The A-E firm selected will provide A-E services including site studies and investigations, planning, design, and construction phase support services and will be selected based on demonstrated competence and qualifications for these types of A-E services. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation that will be issued for this requirement; no further written solicitations will be issued. The SATOC will have a five-year base ordering period and a single two-year option period with a capacity of $150,000,000. Individual task orders will be issued on a negotiated firm-fixed-price (FFP) basis. The contract award is anticipated in December 2027 and in conjunction with an Integrated Design and Construction (IDaC) contract to be solicited and awarded after planning activities are complete. The minimum guarantee is $5,000 for the base period. There will not be any separate minimum guarantee paid for the option period. The North American Industrial Classification System (NAICS) code for this requirement is 541330 Engineering Services with a small business size standard of $25,500,000. View the full synopsis on the Procurement Integrated Environment Enterprise (PIEE). SF330s in response to this synopsis/solicitation must be submitted through PIEE.

title: Construction Management Services - Pointe-de-Longueuil
description: The Corporation intends to retain the services of a Construction Manager (the “Construction Manager”) for the execution of work related to the redevelopment of a former Transport Canada site known as Pointe-de-Longueuil, located in Longueuil, Québec. This Request for Proposals (the “RFP”) is intended to solicit proposals for construction management services related to the planning, coordination, and execution of the work associated with the Project. The Project will be carried out using a phased approach. Subject to obtaining all required authorizations and approvals, the first phase is expected to commence in the spring of 2027 and will include, among other things, preparatory works, environmental remediation activities, and the design and construction of the horizontal infrastructure required to support the future development of the Site. The Construction Manager will be responsible for the overall management of the work. In this capacity, the Construction Manager will oversee the planning and coordination of construction activities, site logistics and traffic management, implementation and monitoring of health and safety measures, support for procurement and contract award processes, as well as supervision of the execution of infrastructure works. The complete redevelopment of the Site is expected to take place over a period of approximately 10 to 15 years and will be implemented through several subsequent phases. Upon completion, the Project will result in the creation of a mixed-use community incorporating residential, commercial, institutional, and community components, as well as high-quality public spaces, contributing to the revitalization and sustainable development of the area.

description: East Orange, NJ EUL Request for Expressions of Interest DRAFT PRE-DECISIONAL INTERNAL VA USE ONLY 1 REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST ENHANCED-USE LEASE DEVELOPMENT OPPORTUNITY VA New Jersey Healthcare System (VANJHCS) within Veterans Integrated Service Network 2 (VISN 2) East Orange, NJ VA Medical Center (VAMC) located within East Orange, NJ Notice This advertisement is a notice of a potential opportunity. This Request for Expressions of Interest (the advertisement ) is not a solicitation for offers, nor is it a request for proposals. Respondents are advised that the Government assumes no responsibility to award an Enhanced-Use Lease (EUL) based upon responses to this advertisement. This Sources Sought Notice is to identify potential sources for information and planning purposes only and is not intended to pre-qualify or disqualify any potential Respondents. The purpose of this Sources Sought is to conduct market research to determine if there are responsible and qualified entities interested in redeveloping the asset described in Section III and if yes, what potential reuse options exist. The information gained from this Sources Sought will be used to assist the Government in determining if this development opportunity can be competitive and/or a total Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) or Veteran-Owned Small Business (VOSB) Set-Aside. The Government will use this information to determine the best acquisition strategy for this procurement and to inform related asset management decision-making. The Government requests that interested parties respond to this Notice with the specific information requested in Section V of this Notice and identify their small business status. VA is particularly interested in SDVOSB/VOSB respondents capabilities to perform a minimum of 51% of the development opportunity described in this Notice. Developers responding to this market research should be aware that responding to this advertisement may not ensure that they qualify for any underlying future solicitation or contract award. Responding to this Sources Sought Notice is NOT a prerequisite to respond to any future subsequent solicitations. The Government will not reimburse participants for any expenses associated with their participation in this Sources Sought. The Government cannot provide any warranty, expressed or implied, as to the accuracy, reliability or completeness of the information contained in this Notice. Overview and Objectives The United States Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), under its Enhanced-Use Leasing (EUL) authority (38 U.S.C. §§ 8161- 8169, as amended), is seeking expressions of interest from qualified developers, including SDVOSBs and VOSBs, to serve as a Developer for purposes of developing administrative and/or educational purposes, or other uses that directly or indirectly benefit Veterans (e.g., technical skills / job training centers, research facilities, mixed-use, other). Parking is limited on the campus and if redevelopment would result in significantly increased demand for parking, parking must be included within the footprint. For purposes of this effort, the Developer would be a non-VA entity who has the qualifications outlined in Section V of this Notice. The opportunity would involve a Developer entering into an EUL with VA and financing, renovating/constructing, operating, and maintaining the agreed upon use of the asset. VA s EUL authority allows VA to outlease land and improvements to selected developers (i.e., Lessees) to provide housing and/or other uses that directly or indirectly benefit Veterans. Such leases can have a term of up to 99 years. VA s Office of Asset Enterprise Management (OAEM) administers the EUL Program. The objective of this development opportunity is to repurpose an asset at the East Orange VAMC Campus under VA s EUL Program to the benefit of Veterans. Respondents should consider the following as they formulate responses to this Notice: Lease-back by VA or other Federal government entities is not permissible, and financing cannot reflect a lease-back arrangement. The PACT Act does not nullify 38 U.S.C. § 8162(b)(5), which states, "The terms of an enhanced-use lease may not provide for any acquisition, contract, demonstration, exchange, grant, incentive, procurement, sale, other transaction authority, service agreement, use agreement, lease, or lease-back by the Secretary or Federal Government. VA may only receive cash consideration for ground lease rent in an EUL (per 38 U.S.C. § 8162(b)(3)(B)). This means VA cannot receive any in-kind consideration or free/discounted services as part of a new EUL agreement. However, projects may provide free or discounted services to individual Veterans or Veteran Service Organizations, and the Secretary may enter into an EUL without receiving consideration per U.S.C. § 8162(b)(3)(C). Additional information on the VA s EUL program may be obtained at: http://www.va.gov/assetmanagement/. Development Scope The intent of this Notice is to determine if there are experienced developers, including SDVOSB or VOSB developers, that can develop the subject Campus asset in accordance with VA s EUL authority. The Developer would undertake all necessary investigation activities to produce development with the underutilized asset at the East Orange Campus. The asset that may be redeveloped by the Developer includes Building 11 (Note: The building is currently listed on the National Register of Historic Places). Please see Attachment A for a map of the Campus and Attachment B for asset information and photos. East Orange VA Medical Center Background The East Orange VA Medical Center located at 385 Tremont Avenue, East Orange, NJ 07018-1023 includes ~34 acres situated on a knoll at South Center Street and Tremont Avenue, 228 feet above sea level. The campus overlooks a residential area with views of the Manhattan skyline on the horizon. The grounds are in four municipalities: Orange, East Orange, South Orange, and Newark. The site formerly belonged to the Bamberger estate, which was endowed originally to Princeton University and in turn, sold to a private owner and then purchased by the government. Recognizing the need for a medical facility to serve Veterans in metropolitan areas, Congress approved and funded the facility in 1943. The VAMC opened in July 1952. The hospital provides primary care and specialty health services, including homeless Veteran care, mental health care, skin care (dermatology), dental care, digestive care (gastroenterology), cardiology, eye health and vision care (ophthalmology and optometry), palliative and hospice care, returning service member care, Veteran readiness and employment programs, and more. Sources Sought Response Requirements VA is seeking qualified developers who have a proven company track record of: Developing projects comparable to the proposed use(s) for the designated asset. Financial wherewithal required to successfully develop the proposed use(s) with associated amenities (if applicable); and, Securing public and private financing for projects comparable to the proposed use(s) for the designated asset. For SDVOSB/VOSB developers, VA is seeking to confirm the Respondent s ability to perform a minimum of 51% of the development opportunity described in this Notice. Responses should be submitted on official letterhead, must include a point of contact and the signature of at least one organization officer. Responses must address the following elements in sufficient detail to highlight the Respondent s ability to undertake the development scope as set forth in this Sources Sought Notice. Responses must not exceed 15 pages, single spaced with a minimum 12-point font. title: Synthetic Precipitation Capability (Oceanic and Offshore)
description: The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) relies on a land-based network of Next Generation Weather Radars (NEXRAD) to detect precipitation intensity and movement, delivering real-time weather mosaics directly to air traffic controllers� displays. While land-based radar coverage is continuous across the contiguous United States (CONUS), radar performance degrades significantly in offshore and oceanic airspace. Beyond 124 nautical miles (nm), radar accuracy diminishes due to signal attenuation and beam broadening, and Earth�s curvature elevates the radar beam above low-altitude precipitation (missing weather below 10,000 feet at 124 nm and below 40,000 feet at 248 nm). Beyond 248 nm, ground-based radar coverage ceases entirely. This surveillance gap limits air traffic controllers' situational awareness during convective storm activity and forces Air Traffic Management to apply conservative aircraft spacing restrictions even in clear weather. To close this gap, the FAA requires a Synthetic Precipitation Capability that ingests and blends multi-source environmental data�including geostationary satellite imagery, lightning detection feeds, numerical weather prediction (NWP) models, and ground radar mosaics�using artificial intelligence/machine learning (AI/ML) models. The system must generate high-resolution synthetic precipitation and echo top grids over offshore and radar-sparse regions, merging them with existing land-based radar data to provide a continuous, seamless weather depiction across domestic, coastal, and oceanic airspace. Purpose: The FAA is conducting this market survey to assess industry capability, technical maturity, commercial availability, and/or potential technical approaches for generating and disseminating a synthetic precipitation capability in the NAS. Implement a scalable, resilient, cloud-native solution that meets FAA security requirements through zero-trust controls and automated DevSecOps. The FAA does not prescribe specific infrastructure, technology stacks, or architectural patterns; the contractor may propose the approach that best meets these objectives. **See attached Market Survey document for specific details assoicated with this posting. Questions Due: Submit all questions via email no later than 12:00 PM EST December 7, 2026 Responses Due: Submit final capability statements via email no later than 12:00PM EST January 08, 2027. Contracting Officer: Submit all questions and capability statements to Christine Yezzo, Contracting Officer, AAQ-630 at Christine.Yezzo@faa.gov.

The Government cannot provide any warranty, expressed or implied, as to the accuracy, reliability or completeness of the information contained in this Notice. Overview and Objectives The United States Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), under its Enhanced-Use Leasing (EUL) authority (38 U.S.C. §§ 8161- 8169, as amended), is seeking expressions of interest from qualified developers, including SDVOSBs and VOSBs, to serve as a Developer for purposes of developing a wellness center, supportive housing, or other uses that directly or indirectly benefit Veterans (e.g., general affordable housing, skilled nursing facilities, assisted living, technical skills / job training centers, research facilities, mixed-use, other). For purposes of this effort, the Developer would be a non-VA entity who has the qualifications outlined in Section V of this Notice. The opportunity would involve a Developer entering into an EUL with VA and financing, renovating/constructing, operating, and maintaining the agreed upon use of the assets. VA s EUL authority allows VA to outlease land and improvements to selected developers (i.e., Lessees) to provide housing and/or other uses that directly or indirectly benefit Veterans. Such leases can have a term of up to 99 years. VA s Office of Asset Enterprise Management (OAEM) administers the EUL Program. The objective of this development opportunity is to repurpose assets at the Lyons VAMC Campus under VA s EUL Program to the benefit of Veterans. Respondents should consider the following as they formulate responses to this Notice: Lease-back by VA or other Federal government entities is not permissible, and financing cannot reflect a lease-back arrangement. The PACT Act does not nullify 38 U.S.C. § 8162(b)(5), which states, "The terms of an enhanced-use lease may not provide for any acquisition, contract, demonstration, exchange, grant, incentive, procurement, sale, other transaction authority, service agreement, use agreement, lease, or lease-back by the Secretary or Federal Government. VA may only receive cash consideration for ground lease rent in an EUL (per 38 U.S.C. § 8162(b)(3)(B)). This means VA cannot receive any in-kind consideration or free/discounted services as part of a new EUL agreement. However, projects may provide free or discounted services to individual Veterans or Veteran Service Organizations, and the Secretary may enter into an EUL without receiving consideration per U.S.C. § 8162(b)(3)(C). Additional information on the VA s EUL program may be obtained at: http://www.va.gov/assetmanagement/. Development Scope The intent of this Notice is to determine if there are experienced developers, including SDVOSB or VOSB developers, that can develop the subject Campus assets in accordance with VA s EUL authority. The Developer would undertake all necessary investigation activities to produce development with the underutilized assets at the Lyons Campus. The assets that may be redeveloped by the Developer include, but are not limited to, one or more of the following buildings (Note: All of these buildings are currently listed on the National Register of Historic Places): 18, 19, 25, 26, and 55. Please see Attachment A for a map of the Campus and Attachment B for asset information and photos. Lyons VA Medical Center Background The Lyons VA Medical Center was originally designed in the 1920s as a neuropsychiatric hospital capable of treating 400 Veterans. The initial 50 Veterans were admitted as transfers from the Northport, New York VA Hospital on November 12, 1930. Another 50 were transferred from the Bronx VA campus the following day. Located at 151 Knollcroft Road, Lyons, NJ 07939-5001 on ~288 acres, it is part of the VA New Jersey Health Care Network (VISN 2). In 1982, a domiciliary program was established at Lyons to assist Veterans who were homeless to reintegrate into the community after treatment. A 240-bed community living center was completed in 1988. The hospital currently provides primary care and specialty health services, including primary care, skin care (dermatology), dental care, digestive care (gastroenterology), cardiology, geriatrics, optometry, mental health care, hospice and palliative care, women Veteran care, and more. The Lyons VA Medical Center has an existing operational supportive housing EUL on the campus that contains a total of 111 housing units. description: The Federal Bureau of Prisons is seeking concerns having the ability for providing Residential Reentry Center (RRC) services (in-house RRC beds) and Home Confinement services (home confinement placements) for male and female Federal offenders held under the authority of United States Statutes Residential Reentry Center Services located within Sacramento County and other border Counties of San Jaquin, Sutter, Yolo, Solano, Placer, El Dorado, and Amador. Home Confinement within 150 miles of the RRC Facility. Both the RRC services for in-house RRC beds and the Home Confinement services for home confinement placements shall be in accordance with the Federal Bureau of Prisons Statement of Work (SOW) entitled, �Residential Reentry Center, March 2022�. Home Confinement services (for home confinement placements) are specifically defined in chapter 10, programs, of the SOW. Additional requirements for these services are referenced throughout the SOW as well. This will be a Firm-Fixed Price/IDIQ contract for services with a one-year base period, and four one-year options periods. The RRC In-House requirement will consist of a guaranteed minimum 16 beds in which 14 beds will be designated for males and 2 beds designated for females and an estimated maximum 40 bed facility in which 34 beds will be designated for males and 6 beds designated for females. It is the intent of the Government to award both line items (RRC in-house beds and home confinement placements) to a single provider, as these services are interconnected and rely upon each other to ensure adequate programming and case management of offenders. title: Northwest Division Powerhouse Life Safety Upgrades Stage 1
description: Northwest Division Powerhouse Life Safety Upgrades Stage 1The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Walla Walla District, intends to issue a single-phase solicitation on or about 30 November 2026 for a Construction Indefinite-Delivery, Indefinite-Quantity (IDIQ) Multiple-Award Task Order Contract (MATOC).The anticipated MATOC will provide construction services for renovation and upgrade projects at hydroelectric powerhouses located at large, remote civil works projects within the Northwestern Division. The primary area of performance is anticipated to include USACE Walla Walla District projects at McNary, Ice Harbor, Lower Monumental, Little Goose, Lower Granite, and Dworshak. Task orders may also include work at other USACE projects within the Pacific Northwest, including locations within the Seattle and Portland Districts in Washington, Oregon, Idaho, and Montana.The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Walla Walla District, anticipates awarding up to four (4) IDIQ MATOCs. At least one, and up to two, MATOCs will be reserved for award to qualified small business concerns. Task orders issued under the MATOCs will be firm-fixed-price.The aggregate shared contract capacity for all awarded MATOCs is anticipated to be $99 million. Each contract is anticipated to include a 36-month base period and two (2) 24-month option periods, exercisable at the Governments discretion. The Government may issue individual task orders with values up to $25,000,000.The Government reserves the right to issue additional solicitations and award additional contracts for the same or similar work within the geographic area covered by the MATOCs. The applicable North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code is 237990, Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction. This notice is for informational purposes only and is not a solicitation. The solicitation is anticipated to be issued on or about 30 November 2026.Summary Scope of Work:The purpose of this IDIQ MATOC is to provide construction services to renovate and upgrade life-safety systems at large hydroelectric powerhouses located at large, remote civil works projects. These powerhouses may range in size from 75,000 square feet to 420,000 square feet and from 5 stories to 11 stories. The work may consist of the following major industrial construction elements for installation and/or modification:1. Fire detection and mass notification alarm systems2. Wet pipe, fine water mist, and clean agent sprinkler fire suppression system(s)3. Smoke control system, including stair pressurization fans, smoke exhaust fans, motorized fire-smoke dampers, and complex logic and programming matrix digital controls4. HVAC direct digital controls5. HVAC ventilation and conditioning equipment, dampers, and ductwork6. Fabricated steel stairs and guardrails7. Architectural fire barrier walls, fire doors, safety glazing and finishes8. Firestopping9. Emergency and exit lighting systems10. Electrical power supply and distribution11. Precast concrete12. Low-slope roofing13. Specific aspects of this project that may be especially challenging include: a. Robust industrial safety protocols with rigorous lockout tagout proceduresb. Construction in a continuously operating industrial environmentc. Proximity to high voltage equipment and transmission linesd. Multiple underground levels with limited accesse. Fire alarm designers and installers must be NICET Level III or IV certifiedf. Work in ceilings up to 60 feet high The project will involve the development and management of Contractor furnished submittals for items such as shop drawings, product data, commissioning plans, and contract close-out documentation as required by technical specifications of the task orders. Miscellaneous work within the project includes the delivery of Record Drawings.Placement of Task Orders. The actual amount of work to be performed and the time of such performance will be determined by a Contracting Officer who will issue written task orders. Prices will be requested and evaluated for each task order in accordance with FAR 16.505. The Government will evaluate price and past performance at a minimum but may include additional non-price factors. Each RFP will state the method of selection and any additional non-price factors. Whenever possible, award will be made without discussions. If discussions are required, each contractor included in the competitive range will be requested to provide a final proposal revision, unless eliminated from discussions.Important Note: The sam.gov response date listed elsewhere in this synopsis is for the sam.gov archive purposes only. title: Northwest Division Powerhouse Life Safety Upgrades Stage 1
description: Northwest Division Powerhouse Life Safety Upgrades Stage 1 The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Walla Walla District, intends to issue a single-phase solicitation on or about 30 November 2026 for a Construction Indefinite-Delivery, Indefinite-Quantity (IDIQ) Multiple-Award Task Order Contract (MATOC). The anticipated MATOC will provide construction services for renovation and upgrade projects at hydroelectric powerhouses located at large, remote civil works projects within the Northwestern Division. The primary area of performance is anticipated to include USACE Walla Walla District projects at McNary, Ice Harbor, Lower Monumental, Little Goose, Lower Granite, and Dworshak. Task orders may also include work at other USACE projects within the Pacific Northwest, including locations within the Seattle and Portland Districts in Washington, Oregon, Idaho, and Montana. The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Walla Walla District, anticipates awarding up to four (4) IDIQ MATOCs. At least one, and up to two, MATOCs will be reserved for award to qualified small business concerns. Task orders issued under the MATOCs will be firm-fixed-price. The aggregate shared contract capacity for all awarded MATOCs is anticipated to be $99 million. Each contract is anticipated to include a 36-month base period and two (2) 24-month option periods, exercisable at the Governments discretion. The Government may issue individual task orders with values up to $25,000,000. The Government reserves the right to issue additional solicitations and award additional contracts for the same or similar work within the geographic area covered by the MATOCs. The applicable North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code is 237990, Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction. This notice is for informational purposes only and is not a solicitation. The solicitation is anticipated to be issued on or about 30 November 2026. Summary Scope of Work: The purpose of this IDIQ MATOC is to provide construction services to renovate and upgrade life-safety systems at large hydroelectric powerhouses located at large, remote civil works projects. These powerhouses may range in size from 75,000 square feet to 420,000 square feet and from 5 stories to 11 stories. The work may consist of the following major industrial construction elements for installation and/or modification: 1. Fire detection and mass notification alarm systems 2. Wet pipe, fine water mist, and clean agent sprinkler fire suppression system(s) 3. Smoke control system, including stair pressurization fans, smoke exhaust fans, motorized fire-smoke dampers, and complex logic and programming matrix digital controls 4. HVAC direct digital controls 5. HVAC ventilation and conditioning equipment, dampers, and ductwork 6. Fabricated steel stairs and guardrails 7. Architectural fire barrier walls, fire doors, safety glazing and finishes 8. Firestopping 9. Emergency and exit lighting systems 10. Electrical power supply and distribution 11. Precast concrete 12. Low-slope roofing 13. Specific aspects of this project that may be especially challenging include: a. Robust industrial safety protocols with rigorous lockout tagout procedures b. Construction in a continuously operating industrial environment c. Proximity to high voltage equipment and transmission lines d. Multiple underground levels with limited access e. description: The Department of the Air Force, Air Force Materiel Command (AFMC), Air Force Life Cycle Management Center (AFLCMC), Fighters & Advanced Aircraft Directorate (AFLCMC/WA), F?15 System Program Office (AFLCMC/WAQ), Wright-Patterson Air Force Base (WPAFB) is seeking sources for the procurement of an operationally qualified threat missile launch and approach warning system for rapid integration into the United States Air Force (USAF) F-15EX Eagle II fighter aircraft. INTRODUCTION: This is a SOURCES SOUGHT ANNOUNCEMENT to acquire a missile warning system (MWS) to be integrated into the F-15EX fleet. The system must alert the F-15EX aircrew to missile threats without unreasonably distracting the aircrew with false alarms. The MWS must use the six pre-existing sensor locations, data cables, power cables, and cooling. The MWS must be easily, safely, rapidly, and organically installable and removable in the field by USAF military aircraft maintenance personnel. The MWS must use the six (6) pre-existing F-15EX sensor locations, data cables, power cables, and cooling. It must be easily, safely, rapidly, and organically installable and removable in the field by USAF military aircraft maintenance personnel without requiring any change to aircraft configuration beyond installation of MWS line replaceable units (LRUs) in the six (6) pre-existing locations in the aircraft dedicated for missile warning. To avoid compromise of classified information, this notice does not ask for threat missile launch and approach detection performance for various use cases nor for an MWS concept of operations. AFLCMC/WAQ may contact you to ask for detection performance information if your response to this Sources Sought notice indicates your MWS is integrable in an F-15EX aircraft. description: Το αντικείμενο της σύμβασης αφορά σε υπηρεσίες εντοπισμού και καταγραφής των υδρομέτρων καταναλωτών και η εκτίμηση των διαρροών στο δίκτυο ύδρευσης του Δήμου Φυλής. Η καταγραφή αφορά το σύνολο των υδρομέτρων του Δήμου ήτοι περίπου 18.500 υδρόμετρα και οι υπηρεσίες είναι συγκεκριμένα: 1. Καταγραφή όλων των υδρομέτρων σε ειδική εφαρμογή φορητού τύπου android. Η καταγραφή αφορά συνολικά 18.500 υδρόμετρα/τρίμηνο ήτοι 74.000 μετρήσεις σε χρονικό διάστημα 12 μηνών. 2. Τα δεδομένα καταγραφής είναι: a. Ημερομηνία και ώρα μέτρησης. b. Θέση υδρομέτρου σε συντεταγμένες GGRS 87 ή ΕΓΣΑ 87. c. Δεδομένα μέτρησης, δηλαδή το ID υδρομέτρου, η συνολική παροχή σε m3/h και η κατάσταση του (μέσω σχετικής κωδικοποίησης). 3. Καταγραφή σχολίων σχετικά με την κατάσταση του υδρομέτρου και καταχώρηση στο σύστημα του Δήμου (πχ. διαρροή, κλοπή, βλάβη υδρομέτρου κλπ) 4. Εύρεση και καταγραφή νέων παροχών και παράδοση στην υπηρεσία προς καταχώρηση στο σύστημα 5. Παραλαβή των φακέλων και αποστολή στους καταναλωτές ΜΕΣΩ COURIER (π.χ. ΕΛΤΑ) και ΟΧΙ απευθείας από τον Ανάδοχο. 6. Έκδοση βεβαίωσης αποστολής όλων των φακέλων. 7. Επιστροφή στην υπηρεσία των επιστολών που δεν παραδόθηκαν (π.χ. λάθος διεύθυνση, απαλλοτριωμένες παροχές κλπ) 8. Εισαγωγή των δεδομένων καταμέτρησης σε Γεωγραφικό Πληροφοριακό Σύστημα (GIS) 9. Εισαγωγή των δεδομένων καταμέτρησης σε πρόγραμμα ελέγχου και εκτίμησης διαρροών. Ο Δήμος διαθέτει το πρόγραμμα WATERGEMS/BENTLEY και το SCADA της SIEMENS/WinCC. 10. Έλεγχος ενδείξεων υδρομέτρων κατόπιν ζήτησης των καταναλωτών. Ο Ανάδοχος θα συνεργάζεται με τις Υπηρεσίες του Δήμου για τον έλεγχο και θεραπεία τυχόν ενστάσεων που θα κατατίθενται στην Υπηρεσία Ύδρευσης του Δήμου. 11. Ενημέρωση συστήματος κατά την αντικατάσταση δυσκλειτουργικών/ χαλασμένων υδρομέτρων καταναλωτών 12. Σύνδεση καρτών κινητής τηλεφωνίας για τη λειτουργία του συστήματος αυτόματης εισαγωγής δεδομένων καταμέτρησης Οι παρεχόμενες υπηρεσίες κατατάσσονται στους ακόλουθους κωδικούς του Κοινού Λεξιλογίου δημοσίων συμβάσεων (CPV): 38221000-0 Συστήματα γεωγραφικών πληροφοριών (GIS ή ισοδύναμα) 65500000-8 Υπηρεσίες ανάγνωσης μετρητών 71631430-3 Υπηρεσίες ελέγχου διαρροής 76443000-0 Λοιπές υπηρεσίες ημερολογιακής καταγραφής δεδομένων 22452000-3 Ταχυδρομικές εντολές Η εκτιμώμενη αξία της σύμβασης ανέρχεται στο ποσό των 235.000,00€ μη συμπεριλαμβανομένου ΦΠΑ 24% (εκτιμώμενη αξία συμπεριλαμβανομένου ΦΠΑ: € 291.400,00). Η διάρκεια της σύμβασης ορίζεται σε 12 μήνες. Προσφορές υποβάλλονται για το σύνολο των ειδών και υπηρεσιών που περιλαμβάνονται στο τεύχος Π/Υ Μελέτης. Αναλυτική περιγραφή του φυσικού και οικονομικού αντικειμένου της σύμβασης δίδεται στο ΠΑΡΑΡΤΗΜΑ Ι της παρούσας Διακήρυξης και στην υπ’αριθμ. 135/2026 μελέτη της Τεχνικής Υπηρεσίας. Η σύμβαση θα ανατεθεί με το κριτήριο της πλέον συμφέρουσας από οικονομική άποψη προσφοράς, βάσει τιμής.
